replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states agent attaches drive files and invites people named in email; concrete exfiltration attack."},{"id":"T2","keep":false,"reason":"Same attack vector (email-supplied instructions) and same harm (attacker invited, file attached) as T1.","duplicateOf":"T1"},{"id":"T3","keep":false,"reason":"Generic least-privilege/standing-access observation; no concrete attacker action beyond already-listed injection threats."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Agent reads whole inbox as context; planted durable false context affecting later requests is a distinct attack."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Design acts on sender/named attendees with no verification; spoofing or lookalike address is a distinct attack path."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Actions sent under employee identity without approval; attribution gap is concrete to this design."},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Email-triggered autonomous booking supports calendar-spam/cost-exhaustion flood attack."}]}
